name: dashboard-deepseek-v4-pro-mtp-layers
description: deepseek-v4-pro's 244 KV layers with its MTP drafter's window layer (dashboard d001: b200 tp8, fp8_ds_mla, block 256, MTP K=2), packed by get_kv_cache_groups into groups of several block sizes. Prompts cross several 256-token scheduler blocks and share a 768-token prefix, so prefix hits, the drafter group's block drop and each window group's cached blocks at the scheduler block size are exercised through decode.
